newsitem.title: USA: Crestar sees Q3 charge of $0.25-$0.30/shr.
newsitem.headline: Crestar sees Q3 charge of $0.25-$0.30/shr.

text.p: Crestar Financial Corp said on Thursday it expects an after-tax charge of about $12 million, or $0.25 to $0.30 per share, in the third quarter as a result of legislation on the Savings Association Insurance Fund and loan loss reserves.
Crestar said it expects a one-time, after-tax charge of $22 million from its assessment for the insurance fund.
Partially offsetting this will be an after-tax gain of $11 million resulting from repeal of a law requiring thrifts to recapture pre-1988 loan loss reserves, it said.
First Call's consensus estimate for Crestar's third quarter earnings is $1.35 per share. First Call said year-earlier earnings were $1.27.
Crestar said it expects to release third quarter results on October 10.
